text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Curren Chan visited a certain 
forest all by herself—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Umm, once we get through this path...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, awesome, awesome♪ There really was a 
waterfall!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, gotta take the photo quick! The 
6:00 AM light is just so gorgeous this 
time of year.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wow, the comments are rolling in already! 
..."An angel exists," "The embodiment of 
cute," "Godly cuteness," it says~

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it was totally worth coming all the 
way out here~ Alright then, all that's 
left is—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: All that's left is to walk home, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—When Curren Chan showed up for training 
on this day, she looked just a little more 
tired than usual."
